title: Stop Saying "Very Nice"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very nice". Use one of these words instead:
• Lovely: a lovely evening
• Delightful: a delightful little café
• Charming: a charming old village
• Wonderful: a wonderful host
• Terrific (informal): a terrific meal

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
